context:
Goal: q_max shows past rates the way you look them up.
Problem (goal): your 12:44 CST condition on item 343. Part of #700 is on main in a generic form: Past Rates has a Group By list in More Filters with year and city. It groups rows by count and year span, with a Year column. The dedicated By Year and By City views are not on main: the median rate per year or city, a year where every rate was refused shown as its own row, and each refusal's own reason.
Based on (read): lane qmax-revive-idle's read of q_max main 58cad3bfb: src/components/SliceExplorer.tsx (Group By); src/utils/corpusSlice.ts (CORPUS_DIMENSIONS); no PastRatesView, decision or tests on main. A stray debt, docs/debts/past-rates-by-year-spacing.md, describes the By Year view that main lacks.
Departs from: main's generic Group By — a adds the dedicated views, with median and refusal logic, beside it.

options.gain: A median rate per year and per city, with each refusal explained.
options.label: Port the dedicated views (recommended: the generic grouping shows no median and no refusal reasons)
options.lose: A lane with a designer and a builder.

options.label: The generic Group By is enough: close #700 and delete the stray debt
options.lose: No medians and no refusal reasons.

reply: a, saved 13:12 CST. Sent to the coordinator: a lane ports #700's By Year and By City views (median per year and city, refusals with reasons) beside main's Group By, with a designer and a design check.
short: #700: generic Group By is on main; port the views?
title: Main already groups Past Rates by year and city, with no medians or refusal reasons. Port #700's dedicated views anyway?
why: Your 343 a said: first confirm it is not on main in any form. The lane found part of it.
